item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1833] Number of active connections between ZeppelinServer and RemoteInterpreterServer keeps growing
item.description:
We have noticed that the number of active connections between ZeppelinServer and jdbc RemoteInterpreterServer keeps growing. We have seen it go as high as 50K.
$ netstat | grep 'localhost:49974' | wc
53374 320244 4750286

ip_local_port_range is 61000-32768 = 28232 ports.
$ sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 32768 61000

So there can be at most 28232*2 = 56464 active connections. After this point, the server fails with:

comments.comment:
I think the problem is in https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/blob/99b975f5c567e025317d5d683f2136fe0c696435/zeppelin-interpreter/src/main/java/org/apache/zeppelin/interpreter/remote/ClientFactory.java#L73
We add Client objects to clientSocketMap but check for PooledObject.

Let me know if this makes sense and I will create a PR.
